heading: Transfer of appropriations by House Leadership Offices

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Each office described under the heading “HOUSE LEADERSHIP OFFICES” in the Act making appropriations for the legislative branch for a fiscal year may transfer any amounts appropriated for the office under such heading among the various categories of allowances and expenses for the office under such heading.

tree.heading: Official expenses
tree.text: Subsection (a) shall not apply with respect to any amounts appropriated for official expenses.

tree.heading: Applicability
tree.text: This section shall apply with respect to fiscal year 1999 and each succeeding fiscal year.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 74a–11 of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section. Section is from the 1999 Emergency Supplemental Appropriations Act.
